{{Quote|You gotta admit. It's a nice place for a meeting.|[[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="SS" />}}
'''Gholondreine-β''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. The [[Gholondreine|native inhabitants]] of Gholondreine-ẞ were known for their [[Scholar/Legends|scholars]] and [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophers]], who held that all [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings owed their highest loyalty to truth. The world had strong ties to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] and, after the [[Declaration of the New Order|proclamation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], began issuing urgent critiques of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine's rule. As punishment, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Desiccation of Gholondreine-β|ordered]] all the [[Water/Legends|water]] to be completely drained from the planet and exported to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], leaving Gholondreine-β an arid wasteland and forcing most residents to flee the dying world.

==Description==
===Planetology===
Gholondreine-ẞ<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="ERC" /> or Gholondreine-Beta<ref name="Blog">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2009/08/endnotes-for-star-wars-essential-atlas_28.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 4 of 5)}}</ref> and Gholondreine-B<ref name="SS" /> or Gholondreine-b,<ref name="AS">''[[Aurra Sing: Dawn of the Bounty Hunters]]''</ref><ref name="CE" /> also known simply as Gholondreine,<ref name="Tumblr">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/21728447315/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-4|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 4}}</ref> was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CE" /><ref name="EU" /> located in the [[Gholondreine system/Legends|Gholondreine system]], within the [[Chitarghar sector/Legends|Chitarghar sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]],<ref name="EAOC" /> not far off the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] and [[Great Gran Run/Legends|Great Gran Run]].<ref name="TEA" />

Once a vibrant planet,<ref name="CE" /> Gholondreine-ẞ was illuminated by the pale light of its home [[Star/Legends|sun]]. Its saline [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]<ref name="SS" /> and green [[Water/Legends|seas]],<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="EU" /> which encircled the globe, harbored shelled marine [[Species/Legends|animals]].<ref name="SS" /> Nevertheless, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], in [[Imperial Era/Legends|its early years]],<ref name="EU" /> deliberately triggered an artificial planetary [[Desiccation of Gholondreine-β|catastrophe]] that obliterated the planet. The Empire drained all the water from the ocean-covered world to the last molecule,<ref name="SS" /><ref name="CE" /><ref name="TEA" /> leaving Gholondreine-ẞ as an arid [[Desert/Legends|desert]] wasteland.<ref name="CE" /> Now, beneath the flat glare of cloud-purged skies, only dust wound through the desiccated surface of the planet – cracked and empty.<ref name="SS" />

The only living creatures on Gholondreine-β capable of surviving in a zero-moisture environment were [[Ithorian crawler|centipedelike beings]] genetically designed by the Empire. They chewed holes into the soft, crumbling stone in the dry trenches of ancient seas, crawling among the dead and hollowed-out remains of the vanished ocean's organisms. The Empire had calculated that when it seeded the [[Insect/Legends|insectoids]] on the surface of the dead world, they would exude [[Poison/Legends|bio-toxins]] with a molecular breakdown rate measurable in [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]. Eventually, the toxin levels would rise high enough to kill the creatures themselves. By then, however, the entire surface crust of the planet would be riddled with their poison-filled boreholes.<ref name="SS" />

===Society===
[[File:GrandConvocationChamber-TOR.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Gholondreine people adhered steadfastly to the Republic's ideals]]
Prior to the Imperial atrocity, the [[Gholondreine|inhabitants]] of Gholondreine-β united in the coastal and inland [[Democracy/Legends|democracies]] across the planet's landmasses.<ref name="SS" /> Their [[City/Legends|cities]] and towns were known for producing renowned [[Scholar/Legends|scholars]] and [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophers]], who held that all sentient beings owed their highest loyalty to truth, however painfully temporal authorities might challenge that allegiance.<ref name="TEA" /> With the rise of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the people of Gholondreine-ẞ maintained strong ties to the ideals of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="CE" /> and, as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] noted, were irritatingly slow to divest themselves of the last vestiges of allegiance to the past era.<ref name="SS" />

==History==
{{Quote|Standard operating procedure for the Empire. Especially when the Emperor's in his punitive mode.|Boba Fett, to Bossk|<ref name="SS" />}}
The space around the future [[Chitarghar sector/Legends|Chitarghar sector]] and the [[Gholondreine system/Legends|Gholondreine star system]] itself was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], as part of the widespread settlement of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Frontier]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Great Peace of the Republic|last centuries]] of the Galactic Republic, the [[Gholondreine|people]] of the planet Gholondreine-ẞ were known for their highest loyalty to truth and [[Democracy/Legends|democratic]] ideals. Their position remained steadfast even after the [[Declaration of the New Order|proclamation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and Gholondreine's inhabitants were reluctant to implement the changes of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Academics across the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] have been deeply alarmed by the atrocities committed by the forces of the Empire. Meanwhile, in [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], a number of Gholondreine [[Scholar/Legends|scholars]] published urgent and scathing critiques of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]'s rule.<ref name="EU" /> When they persisted, the Emperor decided to make an example of their world.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Emperor_Palpatine_AoN.png|thumb|right|220px|Emperor Palpatine exacted brutal retribution on the inhabitants of Gholondreine-ẞ for their disobedience]]
The [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of Gholondreine-ẞ<ref name="SS" /><ref name="CE" /> were swiftly<ref name="EU" /> [[Desiccation of Gholondreine-β|sucked down]] to the last molecule of [[Water/Legends|water]],<ref name="SS" /><ref name="TEA" /> then transported by a fleet of massive Imperial [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] to an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] catalysis plant near [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="SS" /> which served as the «Imperial Center».<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> Economy had not been the motivating factor – it had been more expensive to ship that amount of water than to synthesize it – but punishment had been.<ref name="SS" /> This atrocity forced most residents to escape the dying world,<ref name="CE" /> leaving behind only deserted [[City/Legends|cities]]. Gholondreine exiles established some [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] on the surrounding [[Star system/Legends|system]] worlds, but Palpatine decreed that they would not be allowed to return to their homeworld for a long time.<ref name="SS" /> The dead world was seeded with [[Ithorian crawler]]s<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="EU" /> that were designed to exude a long-lasting [[Poison/Legends|biotoxin]] into the soil. Neighboring worlds in this sector received a valuable object lesson in how to respond to the Emperor's commands.<ref name="SS" />

Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the two [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] met on the dead world of Gholondreine-ẞ, in the depths of a dried marine trench, among moldering crevices and cliff faces.<ref name="SS" /> Both agreed to team up to collect the bounty on [[Trhin Voss'on't]].<ref name="SS" /><ref name="AS" /><ref name="CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|One of my favorite sections of Warfare, from a trilogy that I think has some fantastic elements: the christening of KDY warships, Gholondreine, Kud’ar Mub’at and Balancesheet, and above all else the wonderfully tense showdown between the bounty hunters and the Shell Hutts.|[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''|<ref name="Tumblr" />}}
The first appearance of Gholondreine-ẞ was in the second novel of ''[[The Bounty Hunter Wars]]'' trilogy, ''[[Slave Ship]]'', written by [[K. W. Jeter]] and published in [[October]] [[1998]] by [[Bantam Spectra]].<ref name="SS" /> After writing [[The Essential Atlas]], its co-author [[Jason Fry]] shared in an interview that, when creating the section on Imperial atrocities for the sourcebook, the Dessication of Gholondreine-ẞ was one of his favorite stories.<ref name="Blog" />
